blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) is bringing cloudy skies and rain to Palawan, the Visayas and Mindanao on Tuesday, according to the state weather bureau. READ: Habagat ends but ITCZ brings rain to parts of PH — Pagasa In its 5 a.m. weather forecast, Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather specialist Veronica Torres said the ITCZ, a convergence of winds from the northern and southern hemispheres, would continue to affect Palawan and the Visayas until Wednesday and Mindanao until Saturday. “Sa Visayas at Mindanao, patuloy ang epekto ng ITCZ sa kanilang mga lugar at patuloy […]...
